verdict.rationale: Puzzle's integrations page names connections to Stripe for payments and to Ramp and Brex for spend and cards, with claimed auto-categorization of up to 98%. It also documents bank and credit card reconciliation, so payments and card/banking activity plausibly flow into the ledger. Payroll is never mentioned, and the integration evidence is mostly marketing statistics rather than setup documentation. Missing for 10: any payroll integration, explicit documentation of direct bank-feed connections, detailed integration setup docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
